summary: First-finish smoke test of Emerion Release Vault portal (React + FastAPI + real AWS S3). Backend endpoints and frontend flows all working. Latest version resolution to 2026-06-01 verified end-to-end. Presigned URL downloads valid with 15-min TTL.
passed: GET /api/modules -> EComercial with latest_version=2026-06-01, versions sorted newest-first [2026-06-01,2026-01-01], 5 files, total_size=144286, no zero-byte folder entries
GET /api/modules/EComercial?version=2026-01-01 -> empty files list (version override works)
GET /api/download?key=EComercial/2026-06-01/RELEASE_NOTES.md -> presigned url with expires_in=900, X-Amz-Expires=900; fetching URL returns HTTP 200 with correct 147-byte body
Frontend loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; sidebar shows module-item-EComercial
Latest release banner shows EComercial, 2026-06-01, 5 artifacts, 140.9 KB, 2 versions
Search input filters file list (RELEASE narrows to RELEASE_NOTES.md)
Filter pill 'binaries' shows only EComercial-setup.exe; 'all' resets list
Download button opens presigned-link-modal with 15:00 countdown timer, copy & open buttons present
Version dropdown switch to 2026-01-01 updates banner (2026-01-01, 0 artifacts, 0 B) and shows 'No artifacts found' empty state
notes: Live AWS S3 integration verified (not mocked). Presigned URL fetched directly from S3 returned real file bytes. No credentials file needed (no auth).
